title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of the Company Law of the People's Republic of China (V)

articles.content_en:
Where a connected transaction damages the company's interests, and the plaintiff company requests that the controlling shareholder, actual controller, director, supervisor, or senior officer compensate for the losses caused pursuant to Article 21 of the Company Law, if the defendant only defends on the ground that the transaction has fulfilled the procedures required by laws, administrative regulations, or the company's articles of association, such as information disclosure, approval by the shareholders' meeting or the general meeting of shareholders, the People's Court shall not support such defense.
Where the company does not initiate a lawsuit, the shareholders who meet the conditions set forth in Article 151(1) of the Company Law may initiate a lawsuit in the People's Court pursuant to Article 151(2) and (3) of the Company Law.

Where a connected transaction contract is void or voidable, and the company does not initiate a lawsuit against the counterparty to the contract, the shareholders who meet the conditions set forth in Article 151(1) of the Company Law may initiate a lawsuit in the People's Court pursuant to Article 151(2) and (3) of the Company Law.

Where a director's term of office is terminated before its expiration by a valid resolution of the shareholders' meeting or the general meeting of shareholders, and the director claims that the termination is not legally effective, the People's Court shall not support such claim.
After the director's position is terminated, if a dispute arises over compensation with the company and a lawsuit is initiated, the People's Court shall, pursuant to the provisions of laws, administrative regulations, the company's articles of association, or the contract, comprehensively consider factors such as the reason for termination, remaining term of office, and director's remuneration, to determine whether compensation shall be made and the reasonable amount of compensation.

After a resolution of the shareholders' meeting or the general meeting of shareholders on profit distribution is made, the company shall complete the profit distribution within the time specified in the resolution. If the resolution does not specify a time, the time stipulated in the company's articles of association shall prevail. If neither the resolution nor the articles of association specifies a time, or the time exceeds one year, the company shall complete the profit distribution within one year from the date the resolution is made.
If the time for completing profit distribution specified in the resolution exceeds the time stipulated in the company's articles of association, the shareholders may, pursuant to Article 22(2) of the Company Law, request the People's Court to revoke the provision concerning such time in the resolution.

These Provisions shall come into force on April 29, 2019.
For cases that have not yet been finally adjudicated after these Provisions come into force, these Provisions shall apply; for cases that have been finally adjudicated before these Provisions come into force, or cases retried under the trial supervision procedure, these Provisions shall not apply.
Where any judicial interpretation previously issued by this Court is inconsistent with these Provisions, these Provisions shall prevail.
